name: Eileen Windham
original_name: アイリーン・ウィンダム
source:
[i]"That's when I decided; I'll be the one to protect that person's slumber."[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] Rock
[b]Weapon:[/b] Ninjato

A sisterly vampire hunter with a frank, open-hearted personality. After graduating from the seminary, she did not join the church, but became a gravedigger and hunter, preying on vampires who gather at the cemetery at the foot of the Red Bell Tree.

She and Jack were classmates at the seminary.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=eileen]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
